title: AI and Data Scientist
description: Analyze, predict, and optimize. Master ML algorithms, statistics matrices, mathematical models, and deep learning tools.

nodes.title: Mathematical Foundations
nodes.description: Master linear algebra, matrices operations, calculus gradients, statistics probability distributions, and correlation variables.
projectIdeas: Write Python matrices operations calculations using raw lists, checking mathematical equations results vs NumPy results.
interviewQuestions: What is the Central Limit Theorem and why is it important in statistical experiments?

nodes.title: Machine Learning Algorithms
nodes.description: Implement regression models, decision trees, random forests, clustering techniques, and evaluation metrics (precision/recall/F1).
projectIdeas: Build a house pricing estimation model using linear regression and validate score accuracies using Scikit-Learn metrics.
interviewQuestions: What is the difference between bagging and boosting algorithms?
Explain overfitting and how regularization techniques (L1/L2) mitigate it.

nodes.title: Deep Learning (PyTorch)
nodes.description: Construct multi-layer neural networks, backpropagation pathways, activations functions (ReLU, Sigmoid), and weights optimization.
projectIdeas: Build an image recognition classifier system that correctly labels handdrawn digits using PyTorch layers.
interviewQuestions: What does backpropagation do in neural network training loops?
Why do we use activations functions inside hidden nodes layers?
